title: Troy (Civ5)/Civilopedia
comment: Created page with "<noinclude>{{Civilopedia|Civilopedia (Civ5)}}</noinclude> The legendary city of Troy, presumed to have reached its pinnacle in the 3rd and 2nd millennium BC, was a prosperous center of trade on the Aegean Sea. Featured predominantly in Homer's epic poem the "Iliad," the city was long thought to have been purely mythological. However, archaeological discoveries in the 19th century unearthed remnants in modern Turkey believed to have been the city of Troy."

title: Nakhchivan (Civ5)/Civilopedia
comment: Created page with "<noinclude>{{Civilopedia|Civilopedia (Civ5)}}</noinclude> Spanning territories in Armenia, Iran and Turkey, the landlocked region of Nakhchivan is said to have been colonized more than 5,000 years ago. Throughout its history the region would be embroiled in a number of military campaigns involving the Persian empires as well as the Macedonians. Nakhchivan still exists today as a region of the Republic of Azerbaijan."
